name: Fitted Table Cover  (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
descriptionHtml:
Create a polished, professional table display with our Fitted Table Cover, designed to deliver full-bleed, edge-to-edge branding with a tailored, structured fit. Ideal for trade shows, vendor booths, exhibitions, and corporate events, this cover instantly elevates your brand presentation while maintaining a clean and organized look.

Printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation, your artwork appears vibrant, sharp, and long-lasting. The fitted design covers three sides of the table, leaving the back open for easy storage access—making it a practical and cost-effective solution for busy event environments.

🔹 Key Features

🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Crisp, vibrant, fade-resistant graphics
🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge custom branding
🧵 Display Polyester Fabric – Durable material with a professional finish
📐 Fitted Table Design – Clean, tailored look for event tables
📦 Open Back (Economy Style) – Easy access for storage under the table
🎒 Optional Carry Bag – Convenient transport and storage

🔹 Available Table Sizes

📏 8ft Table: 96"W × 30"H × 30"D
📏 6ft Table: 72"W × 30"H × 30"D
📏 4ft Table: 48"W × 30"H × 24"D
📏 4ft Tall Table: 48"W × 36"H × 24"D

📌 Dimensions may vary slightly by table style.

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Display Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, brand activations, and corporate events.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
